newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Cedel Bank gets S&P AA+, IBCA AA long-term ratings.
newsitem.headline: Cedel Bank gets S&P AA+, IBCA AA long-term ratings.

text.p: Cedel Bank, the Luxembourg-based international depository, said on Monday it had been assigned long-term ratings by Standard & Poor's and IBCA Ltd for the first time.
The S&P rating was AA+, the IBCA rating AA.
"This reflects the bank's excellent asset quality, never having suffered a credit loss in its 26-year history, its highly liquid balance sheet and sound capitalisation," Cedel said.
Cedel Bank contains the Cedel Group's core clearing and settlement business, and an order routing service between North America and Europe.
